notes_for_editor: Two Etoile sites: FFLA Loc 1 (31.36111, -94.38861) is gone and Loc 2 (31.33156, -94.36711, the record) is standing. The 1949 Coast and Geodetic Survey description names Etoile Lookout Tower No. 6 but does not say which site it was, so the record is unchanged. Edward Cavallerano's book (SearchWorks record) was not read. Used 2 WebSearch and about 9 page reads, over the per-tower budget. Nothing found on build date, design, height, staffing, fires or access.
